title: ES-Plus EsTable columns
description: Schema for the columns prop passed to <es-table />. GENERATED from packages/shared/schemas/table-column.schema.json by scripts/gen-doc-schemas.mjs — do not hand-edit.

items.title: EsTable Column Configuration
items.description: Configuration for a single column in @es-plus/vue3 EsTable component. Every column must be at least one of: addressable (prop or key), a built-in special column (type: selection/expand/index), or a multi-level header group (groups). A column with none of these renders nothing.

prop.description: Data field name in the row object

key.description: Alternative to prop. Column unique identifier (converted to prop internally)

labelKey.description: i18n translation key for the column header. When a global t() function is configured via app.use(ESPlus, { t }), the header will be translated using t(labelKey). Falls back to label when t() is not configured

fixed.description: Fix column to left or right side

formatter.description: Function (row) => string. Format cell display value

render.description: Custom render function (h, { row, value, index }) => VNode

scopedSlots.description: Named slot configuration for custom column rendering

customRender.description: Slot name to use for rendering this column

groups.description: Nested child columns for multi-level headers

ellipsis.description: Enable text overflow ellipsis with tooltip

btns.description: Row operation buttons (typically used in an 'actions' column)

clickEvent.description: Function (row) => void. Click handler receiving the row data

permissionValue.description: Permission code for button visibility. When a global permission() function is configured, buttons with unmatched permissionValue will be hidden

type.description: Special column type: selection checkbox, expand row, or row index

expandConfig.description: Row-expand content for a `type: 'expand'` column (AI-09 子项②). When set, the row expander renders a read-only `label: value` list from `row[prop]` for each entry in `fields` (display order preserved). Usually supplied via the top-level StructuredCrudConfig.expandConfig, which the generator maps onto the expand column. Distinct from tableOptions.expandConfig (the vxe `{ accordion }` switch).

title.description: Optional heading rendered above the field list

fields.description: Detail fields to show, in display order

prop.description: Row key to read the value from

labelKey.description: i18n key for the label (takes precedence over `label`)

emptyPlaceholder.description: Placeholder text for empty cell values

editRender.description: Column-level inline editor (AI-09 子项④). vxe engine only — requires tableOptions.editConfig AND tableOptions.engine: 'vxe'. Marks THIS column editable and picks its editor; a column without `editRender` is not editable. Function-valued fields (events) and custom-registered renderers are out of scope.

name.description: Inline-edit renderer name, e.g. '$input' | '$select' | '$textarea' | '$date' (vxe engine only)

type.description: 'default' = enter edit on trigger; 'visible' = editor always shown

options.description: Option list for a '$select' editor (label/value pairs)

props.description: Props forwarded to the editor component

autofocus.description: Focus the editor when it opens

defaultValue.description: Default value seeded into the editor
